{{Quote|I don't care how important ''you'' think you are. My orders are to send people in ''only'' after they've been checked. You'll have to wait your turn.|Munten|<ref name="Shadows" />}}
[[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] '''Munten''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|security]] [[Police officer/Legends|officer]] in the tower office of the [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], during [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Valorum's]] term. His duties included manually checking anybody wanting to enter the building. During the last days of the organization known as [[The Flail]], he had to deal with long queues of people.<ref name="Shadows" />
